description: A Rust workspace that publishes nothing to crates.io and ships a built artifact, such as a game mod. Same rules as rust-crates, except that a toolchain bump is a fix, by the rule below. The difference is what the repository adds, such as a submodule pointer or a crate it consumes from crates.io.

packageRules.description: The toolchain builds the artifact this repository ships, and the standard library links into that binary, so a bump ships.
